verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud automatically generates text embeddings with local models, and you can choose the embedding model per collection (orama-docs-47, orama-docs-49). For the open-source library, the embeddings plugin vectorizes documents at insert time and queries at search time, including converting query text to vectors without exposing an OpenAI key (orama-docs-7, orama-docs-42). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of embedding quality and setup; detailed docs on supported models.
